physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the gall bladder, a small green organ tucked under the liver, the body's holding tank for bile and, in Chinese medicine, the seat of the decision to act. Courage was said to live here. So was the bracing flinch that comes when life turns a corner you did not see. It is fitting. This is the code of the shock and the leap, and the gall bladder is the organ that has to release on cue, that has to let go at the right moment or the body will not be able to use what it is eating.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. Long agitation makes the gall bladder tight. The release that should come easily comes grudging, or in a rush, or not at all. Sleep stays shallow. The jaw locks. The body holds itself ready for a blow it cannot place, and the small green organ takes the brunt of that vigilance, hardening over the years into stones, into a sharp pain under the right ribs.

The climb out is bodily too. The release softens. A decision can be made without churning. The startle still arrives, because shocks still come, but it passes through. The body stops bracing as its default position. Initiative is not a thought you have. It is the gall bladder remembering that it knows how to let go.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Arginine. Arginine is the body's quiet messenger for opening. It is the precursor the cells use to make nitric oxide, the small signal that tells the blood vessels to relax and widen, that lets blood reach where blood needs to reach. Constriction yielding to flow. That is the chemistry running under this card.

There is a teaching in that. The whole shadow of this code, the bracing, the half-readiness, the tightening against the next shock, is constriction. The whole gift, the leap, the giving without a wall in front of it, is flow. The body has been saying the same thing all along, lower down than any teacher. Open the vessel. Let it through.

The code runs all the way to this: a chemistry whose entire job is to widen what was narrowed, to release what was clenched. The awakening promised at the top of the card is already happening at the level of one molecule, every time the body lets the blood move.
